name: Chicken Breast
description: A simple breaded chicken breast recipe.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash chicken breast.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and seasoning.
Dip in milk, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs.
Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 350°F until golden.
Serve with rice or noodles.

_similar.name: Boneless Chicken Breasts
_similar.description: A stuffed boneless chicken breast recipe with ham, cheese, and onions.

recipeInstructions.text: Pound chicken with a frying pan or mallet, skin side down.
Layer with ham, cheese, and onions.
Roll up and dip in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumbs.
Put in a cake or casserole pan and bake at 350°F for 1/2 hour or until chicken is cooked.

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.
